fusion.wire_convention: byte-major; wire8*b+j is MSB-indexed output bit j of byte b
fusion.proof: CNOT/X affine form is completely determined by zero and32 basis vectors.
fusion.placement: For each forward non-final round, strip A from16 C0 calls; after ShiftRows apply M composed with A on each group of4 output bytes. Keep A in round10. Reverse uses ordinary M inverse because stored round values are still standard M(S(x)).
fusion.caveat: No gate-count or depth improvement claimed: this exports a verified joint affine synthesis target. Existing C0 macro verification must be updated to the stripped event stream; treating it as standard S output would be incorrect.
